title: Persist Hermes agent/session across TS voice turns
description: The TS Hermes bridge currently instantiates a fresh AIAgent inside the worker for each turn. Replace that with persistent per-conversation agent/session state so history and agent context are not rebuilt from scratch every turn.

title: Strip stage-direction text from hub TTS
description: Summary: hub-side sanitizeSpokenText still lets stage-direction and markdown emphasis text leak into spoken audio on the Pi/Amica path. Scope: harden src/ts/shared/text.ts so TTS strips starred/stage-direction text more defensively before relay.tts and streamed assistant audio chunking, and validate the TS build/check. Example: '*Soft laugh, ears tilting* Appreciate the view, babe.' should speak only 'Appreciate the view, babe.'

title: Add OpenAI-compatible audio relay for Amica
description: Add a local HTTP facade on the Pi client that exposes OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions and /v1/audio/speech endpoints for Amica. Keep the existing hub/satellite websocket path intact, route STT/TTS through opanhome instead of direct browser-side sidecar behavior, and leave the existing mic control endpoint available. Include request/response shapes that Amica's openai_whisper and openai_tts backends already expect.
close_reason: Completed: added local OpenAI-compatible speech relay on the Pi, relayed STT/TTS over the existing hub websocket, validated /v1/audio/speech and /v1/audio/transcriptions on the Pi, and deployed the relay-only satellite mode for Amica.

title: Fix owner-mode segment race without removing streamed TTS
description: The previous owner-mode patch removed segment-by-segment assistant delivery and broke the intended low-TTFT streaming behavior. Scope: restore streamed assistant.segment delivery, make the Pi client tolerate text/audio segment ordering races without failing closed, and fix Amica chat text joining/finalization so assistant segments do not concatenate incorrectly across boundaries.

title: Stabilize owner-mode assistant turn assembly for Amica satellite
description: The Pi owner-mode bridge is racing assistant live text against audio-init/audio-end segment boundaries. Symptoms: truncated TTS playback, fail-closed on empty assistant text/audio segments, and mixed assistant text in the Amica chat box. Scope: make owner-mode accumulate full assistant audio across the turn, post a single assistant.final payload when the turn completes, and stop treating empty intermediate segment boundaries as fatal.

title: Harden TS hub DNS resolution for Deepgram and ElevenLabs
description: The realtime voice hub intermittently fails live Pi turns because Node websocket connects to api.deepgram.com and api.elevenlabs.io can raise getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND even when host-level DNS is otherwise healthy. Scope: add a repo-owned DNS fallback for the hub websocket clients, wire it into Deepgram realtime STT and ElevenLabs streaming TTS, rebuild, validate the hub starts cleanly, and verify Pi turns recover.
close_reason: Superseded by restoring stable voice path; no code change shipped

title: Add Pi tracker debug UI and LAN control surface
description: Summary: add a Pi-side HTTP debug/control surface for the TS realtime client so the satellite can expose tracker/video diagnostics and runtime controls on the LAN. Scope: extend the Pi client service with a LAN-bound debug server on port 3001, show current audio/mic state, expose tracker telemetry/feed hooks, and provide control endpoints the Amica side can use for tuning. Files likely include src/ts/pi-client/*, scripts/deploy-ts-pi-client.sh, and any repo-owned service/env wiring needed for deployment. Validation: the Pi client can serve a debug page on :3001, existing mic control on 8790 still works, and the deployed Pi exposes the page on the LAN.
close_reason: Superseded by tracker-side debugger implementation in psfn-amica rather than the TS Pi client.

title: Add optional Amica bridge to TS Pi client
description: Implement an optional, fail-closed Amica bridge in the opanhome TS Pi client. The client should forward finalized user text, finalized assistant text, and buffered assistant mp3 audio to a local Amica HTTP endpoint when bridge config is present. Keep the change modular in src/ts/pi-client, preserve current behavior when bridge config is absent, and support owner mode where local assistant audio playback is disabled in favor of bridge playback timing. Use the existing Amica satellite bridge contract (/api/satelliteBridge) and require bridge config to be complete.

title: Fix TS Pi player overlap on interrupt
description: Interrupts can leave the previous ffmpeg/aplay pipeline alive, so old speech keeps playing and overlaps the next response. Fix the TS Pi audio player to kill the full playback process group and ignore stale close events from superseded player generations.

title: Add wake-word gating to TS realtime client
description: The realtime Pi client needs a wake-word path so turns can be opened intentionally instead of always-on speech triggering. Scope: define how wake-word entry works on the Pi-class client path and how it interacts with barge-in, interrupt, and active conversation state.

title: Add sleep mode that requires wake word before listening
description: The realtime Pi client needs an explicit sleep mode. When asleep, it must not actively listen for normal turns and should only resume conversational listening after the wake word is detected. Scope: sleep/wake state model, client UX, and interaction with existing interrupt and follow-up logic.

title: Fix Hermes voice identity prompt on TS path
description: The TS realtime hub currently prompts the model as if it were the remote satellite, so identity questions answer as hardware instead of Hermes. Update the system prompt so the assistant identifies as Hermes and never as the device.
close_reason: Replacing fake model wrapper with real Hermes AIAgent bridge in progress; closing after push in same turn is okay if pushed

title: Port TS realtime voice path to reference streaming interrupt pattern
description: Replace the TS hub and Pi client turn-gated flow with the reference continuous audio stream, explicit interrupt-event/bot-speak-end semantics, and server-side utterance boundaries so interrupt/follow-up behavior matches the working design.

title: Rewrite realtime voice hub and Pi client in TypeScript
description: Replace the current Python realtime hub/client path with a TypeScript implementation modeled on the working reference app. Scope includes a TS hub websocket transport, TS Pi client with local playback ownership and barge-in, Deepgram/Hermes/ElevenLabs streaming, and deployment to the Pi 5 test target while keeping the stock ESPHome path available as fallback.
close_reason: TypeScript realtime hub and Pi client implemented and deployed

title: Fix Hermes voice worker for reasoning-first streams
description: The realtime voice hub's Hermes streaming worker uses raw chat.completions streaming. After the Hermes/OpenRouter update, the selected model emits reasoning-first deltas, so the worker sees empty content and returns no spoken reply. Disable reasoning for the voice path and verify the worker streams visible text again.
close_reason: Disabled reasoning for the voice worker's raw streamed completions; verified the Hermes streaming provider returns visible text again after the Hermes/OpenRouter update.

title: Tune Pi realtime client VAD and interrupt behavior on live hardware
description: Now that the dedicated Pi websocket client is deployed, tune local speech start thresholds, interrupt sensitivity, and follow-up timing against real room audio so it does not false-start or miss barge-in on the Pi W 2.

title: Build dedicated Pi realtime client and retire linux-voice-assistant on Pi W 2
description: Create and deploy the dedicated low-latency Pi client that talks to the hub realtime websocket protocol, then disable the linux-voice-assistant service on the current Pi endpoint while keeping the stock ESPHome path available as a fallback in the hub.
close_reason: Dedicated Pi realtime client deployed to 192.168.1.173; linux-voice-assistant disabled there; new service active and connected to hub realtime websocket.

title: Add speech-first barge-in for follow-up turns
description: Support more natural interruption than wake-word-only by using speech-driven barge-in behavior similar to the /mnt/ai/App.tsx client: immediate playback duck/stop on user speech, clean cancellation of active response generation, and continued conversation without requiring a fresh wake word when the endpoint supports it. Scope includes verifying which part must live in the ESPHome/Linux endpoint versus the hub transport.

title: Instrument and trim end-to-end voice turn latency
description: Measure STT finalize, Hermes first-token, TTS first-audio, and total turn latency so we can remove avoidable waits and tune thresholds based on real numbers.

title: Reduce streaming TTS choppiness with phrase buffering
description: Smooth reply playback by batching Hermes deltas into short phrase-sized chunks before flushing to ElevenLabs, while keeping first-audio latency low.

title: Optimize ESPHome voice bridge for speed and smoothness
description: Track the work to make the ESPHome/Linux voice endpoint path feel fast, reliable, and PR-ready for eventual Hermes upstreaming. Scope includes STT/TTS latency, smoother playback, tighter timeout/recovery behavior, and clarifying the Hermes sidecar vs core integration seam.

title: Harden public-push Pi client defaults
description: Remove host-specific and session-specific hardcoded defaults from the TS/Python Pi client and deploy scripts. Keep optional features optional, and fail closed when an enabled path is missing required config. Update env examples and deploy scripts to use generic placeholders instead of lab-specific values.

title: Document Hermes pass-through ownership in README
description: Update README so the TS hub is described as a satellite bridge that passes turns to Hermes with a stable conversation id, while Hermes owns conversation/session state.

title: Refresh README for TS realtime architecture
description: Document the current TypeScript realtime hub and Pi client path, the ESPHome fallback path, deployment steps, and current working topology in README.md.

title: Add repo-local .agents Hermes home and wrapper
description: Verify the updated Hermes install still connects, add a repo-local .agents scaffold for this workspace, point the local hermes wrapper at the updated global install with a local HERMES_HOME, and smoke-test that Hermes runs from this directory without touching the user\'s global Hermes home.

title: Harden stuck-turn recovery for ESPHome satellite sessions
description: Keep the satellite responsive when STT, Hermes, or TTS stalls by tightening bounded timeouts, cancellation, and artifact logging for failure diagnosis.

title: Choose Hermes upstream path for ESPHome voice support
description: Decide whether the upstreamable integration should remain a sidecar with a thin Hermes streaming seam, or become a first-class gateway platform after the transport is proven stable.
